verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so API parity with the UI is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only UI workflows, Excel exports, bulk upload and a Gusto integration, and never mentions a public API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404. The Gusto sync is a vendor-to-vendor integration, not a user-facing API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
